config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-cybersource
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/cybersource/v1/sessions&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=400,422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/cybersource/v1/payments&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=400,422"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=GET&path=/cybersource/v1/payments/{reference}&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200,404"
              - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                steps:
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-http-call?url=http://mw-simulators:8080&method=POST&path=/cybersource/v1/payments/{reference}/refunds&auth=hmac-sha256&secretField=hmac-secret"
                  - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=404,422"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
